n86cd859146.headline: 2024 Budget will support IMF-backed Post-Covid-19 Programme of Economic Growth – Finance Ministry

n86cd859146.why: The national budget sets government spending, revenue and deficit targets, and it signals the fiscal path agreed under the IMF programme that investors monitor for Ghana's debt risk.

n4bacfc8947.headline: Glencore-Led Group to Buy Teck's Coal Business -- Commodities Roundup
n4bacfc8947.summary: A group led by Glencore agreed to buy Teck Resources' coal business. Brent crude was up 0.1% at $82.63 a barrel and gold futures were flat at $1,950.60 an ounce.
n4bacfc8947.why: Glencore is a Swiss-based global commodities trader and miner, and Teck Resources is a Canadian mining company, so this deal reshapes coal supply among major miners.

n9c8cdf90c0.headline: Over 100 Digital Loan Apps Have Been Blacklisted in Pakistan

nda5944820f.headline: Zimbabwe platinum miners ask government to defer export tax

nda5944820f.why: Platinum is a key metal used in autocatalysts and jewellery. Export taxes on concentrates affect miner margins and the economics of local processing.
